subject: Solarevo - CIO & VP presence for executive demo / brief (scheduling and agenda)
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Iyengar <rajesh.iyengar@solarevo.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Solarevo executive demo - request for CIO & VP alignment

Hi Rajesh,

Thanks again for the time last week — delighted Solarevo is exploring Redwood for inference at scale. I wanted to find a short window to get the right execs in the room so we can align on success criteria before a deeper technical walkthrough. Specifically: would your CIO (you) and the VP of Platform (or VP of Eng) be available for a 30–40 minute executive brief followed immediately by a 45–60 minute technical demo with our Solutions Engineer?

Proposed approach:
- 30 min executive brief (business metrics, integration model, SLA & compliance guardrails) — Mateo + Grace from Redwood, Rajesh + VP from Solarevo
- 60 min technical demo (model serving, latency/cost tradeoffs, dedicated vs private deployment) — Marissa leading demo
- Outcome: mutual action plan and next steps (pilot scope, timelines, POC resources)

Two tentative windows next week that work for us (PST):
1) Tue Nov 30, 2026 — 11:00–12:40 PST (exec brief 11:00–11:30; demo 11:35–12:35)
2) Wed Dec 1, 2026 — 08:30–10:10 PST

If neither works, share three slots that fit your executive calendars and we’ll mirror the session plan. I’m attaching a draft agenda and a short SOW stub to help your procurement team scope the pilot.

Attachments: solarevo-demo-agenda-v1.docx; redwood-sow-draft.pdf

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Rajesh Iyengar <rajesh.iyengar@solarevo.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@solarevo.com>, Solarevo Demo Ops <demos@solarevo.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solarevo executive demo - request for CIO & VP alignment

On Sun, Nov 15, 2026 at 9:12 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the time last week — delighted Solarevo is exploring Redwood for inference at scale.

Hi Mateo — apologies for the delay, been triaging an outage this morning. Appreciate the clear plan. The CIO (me) is available for the first window on Tue Nov 30, 11:00 PST — I can join the exec brief but will need to drop after the first 45 minutes. I’ve asked Lydia (VP, Platform) to confirm her availability; she is OOO Tue morning but might be able to join remotely for the exec portion if we hold to the 30-minute brief.

If VP can't make it, could we still do a 30-minute exec brief (me + a senior Eng lead) and then proceed with the technical demo for the team? Also, please include any compliance touches (SOC2, data residency) in the brief — procurement will want an overview.

I'll let Lydia confirm by EOD. If she can't make 11:00, Wed Dec 1 08:30 PST also works for us.

—Rajesh
CIO, Solarevo Energy
rajesh.iyengar@solarevo.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Iyengar <rajesh.iyengar@solarevo.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Solarevo Demo Ops <demos@solarevo.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2026 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solarevo executive demo - request for CIO & VP alignment

Thanks Rajesh — great, we’ll lock Tue Nov 30 at 11:00–12:35 PST with the following clarifications:

- 11:00–11:30 PST — Executive brief (CIO + VP if available). I’ll cover product fit, SLA/cost posture, and pilot success criteria. Grace will cover reliability & rollout model.
- 11:30–12:30 PST — Technical demo run by Marissa (deep dive on serving runtime, routing, quantization, and integration patterns).
- 12:30–12:35 PST — Decision & next steps (pilot owner, target date, procurement touchpoints).

Marissa — can you run the demo and prepare a short appendix on integration checklist (expected API calls, auth/KMS, and sample rollout config)? I attached the latest agenda and SOW stub for Rajesh and Lydia to circulate internally.

Rajesh — noted on compliance. Grace, can you include a two-slide SOC2/data flow summary in the exec brief?

I’ll send a calendar invite in the next 30 min. If Lydia confirms she can only join for the exec brief, we’ll keep the demo scheduled and record it for broader Eng review.

Attachments: solarevo-demo-agenda-v1.docx; redwood-sow-draft.pdf

Cheers,
Mateo

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Iyengar <rajesh.iyengar@solarevo.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Solarevo Demo Ops <demos@solarevo.com>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@solarevo.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solarevo executive demo - request for CIO & VP alignment

Locked and added. I’ll run the technical demo and include an integration appendix + brief quantization/cost slide.

Quick notes for the team: 
- Please upload any sample traffic patterns or token-length distributions you want mirrored in the demo to the linked runbook before 9:00 AM PST on Tue: https://share.redwood.com/demo-runbook/solarevo
- Procurement: if you want prefilled estimates, drop the expected pilot QPS and retention window. I can provide a 3-tier cost comparison (hosted / dedicated / private) during the brief.

I’ll also produce a 2-slide SOC2 summary for Grace to blend into the exec section.

See you all at 11:00 PST. Invite sent.

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
